newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh fires central bank chief.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh fires central bank chief.

text.p: Bangladesh's central bank Governor, Khorshed Alam, was dismissed Thursday for alleged irregularities and a lack of control over his subordinates, Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said.
"The governor has been relieved of his contract on the basis of an inquiry report," Kibria told a news conference.
"The inquiry found that the governor had no control over his subordinates. Also he was found lenient about irregularities," a Finance Ministry official said.
The inquiry was launched in September, two months after the new government of Prime Minister Sheikhh Hasina took office, the official said without giving details.

Officials said the inquiry followed allegations that a deputy governor of the Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, had issued licenses to some non-banking financial institutions without prior approval.
The deputy governor, Mahbubur Rahman, had been suspended earlier.
Alam was immediately replaced by Lutfar Rahman Sarkar, a career banker and the chief executive of the Prime Bank, a leading private sector bank.
Alam was not immediately available for comment.
